Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters


About the Role
Assemble, install, alter, and repair pipelines or pipe systems that carry water, steam, air, or other liquids or gases. May install heating and cooling equipment and mechanical control systems. Includes sprinkler fitters.
What You'll Do
Shut off steam, water, or other gases or liquids from pipe sections, using valve keys or wrenches.
Install underground storm, sanitary, or water piping systems.
Assemble pipe sections, tubing, or fittings using couplings, clamps, screws, bolts, cement, or welding equipment.
Locate and mark the position of pipe installations, connections, passage holes, or fixtures.
Cut, thread, or hammer pipes to specifications, using tools such as saws, cutting torches, or pipe threaders.
Review blueprints, building codes, or specifications to determine work details or procedures.
Select pipe sizes, types, or related materials according to specifications.
Fill pipes or plumbing fixtures with water or air and observe pressure gauges to detect leaks.


Tools & Technology
Autodesk Building Systems (CAD software)
Heat loss calculation software (Analytical software)
FastEST FastPipe (Project management software)
Education & Experience
Education: Post-secondary certificate or High school diploma or equivalent
On-the-Job Training: 4 to 10 years
Related Work Experience: 4 years to 6 years
Work Environment
Wear safety equipment
Exposed to contaminants
Freedom to make decisions
High time pressure
